dedupe_keys.name: 充電設備設置施設一覧 electricity and power

description: 充電設備設置施設一覧 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊田市. 世代自動車である電気自動車（EV）・プラグインハイブリッド車（PHV）と太陽光発電システムの一体的な普及展開を図り設置した充電設備の一覧です。. Coverage: 豊田市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊田市. Its tags are 位置情報, 生活情報, 生活支援. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
